decisions.title: Track everything in a JSON file in the repo
decisions.why: Every update is a git commit, so the history is auditable and the dashboard is just a static page on GitHub Pages — no server to run.

decisions.title: Target ages 4–10 heritage learners, not adult learners
decisions.why: They already hear Arabic at home; reading + linking dialect to standard Arabic is the unmet need.

decisions.title: Interface in English & French, content in Arabic
decisions.why: Kids are schooled in the local language; France and Canada are large early markets.

decisions.title: Web app (PWA) first, app stores later
decisions.why: Ships fastest, no store fees, works offline, one codebase; wrap for stores in Q2 2027.

decisions.title: Weekend schools are a channel, not a competitor
decisions.why: They gather motivated families and need homework between classes.

decisions.title: Teach standard spelling, show the home word beside it
decisions.why: Kids read standard Arabic in books but hear dialect at home; showing both says 'both are Arabic' instead of 'you're wrong'.

decisions.title: Stay lean until pilot retention is proven
decisions.why: Salaries, not demand, decide the cash need: lean path needs ~$70k vs $250k+ when hiring early.

decisions.title: Permanent home: shibl.github.io/learnArabic
decisions.why: Free, served straight from the repo, updates on every push; custom domain later once the brand name is chosen.

decisions.title: Name: Sindibad Letters · حروف سندباد, a Sindibad Studios product
decisions.why: Owner's choice; ties the app to the studio and the Sindibad & Yasmina world (islands, hoopoe guide). Sindbad is public domain, so distinctiveness comes from the studio brand.

decisions.title: Use a subdomain, keep sindibad.studio for the studio site
decisions.why: The apex already hosts the studio site; arabic.sindibad.studio keeps both live.

decisions.title: Labour is free in the financial model
decisions.why: The owner's existing full-time team (already paid) builds, writes and designs; only cash costs (marketing, ads, hosting, legal) are modelled.

decisions.title: Marketing = growth loop, ads only as accelerator
decisions.why: Child's voice shared on family WhatsApp + relatives gifting + schools earning 20% share recruit and fund new families; ads are scaled only when cost per payer stays under what a payer returns.

decisions.title: School partners earn 20% of subscriptions they refer
decisions.why: Weekend schools need funding; revenue share turns them into active promoters at near-zero acquisition cost.

needsYou.title: Pilot sign-up form
needsYou.detail: Pick one: (a) I build a free Google Form / Tally form you own, or (b) give me an email address to receive sign-ups. No child data collected.

needsYou.title: Point arabic.sindibad.studio at GitHub (DNS)
needsYou.detail: At your domain registrar add: CNAME record, host 'arabic', value 'shibl.github.io'. Then GitHub → Settings → Pages → Custom domain: arabic.sindibad.studio → Save, and tick Enforce HTTPS when it appears.

needsYou.title: Send the audio zip
needsYou.detail: When recording is done, attach the zip in chat. Guide: docs/10-audio-recording-guide.md

log.text: Tracker: clicking an area now opens a detail panel (in progress, next, done, recent activity, documents) and scrolls to it; shareable links like /tracker/#eng.

Rethought marketing as a growth loop. Ads alone decay ($42 per paying family vs $26 first-month cash). Adding child-voice sharing, family gifting and school revenue share makes it self-reinforcing: ×5.4 in a year, ×3.8 even with pricier ads.
Owner's existing full-time team covers all labour → model updated to cash costs only. Base case: break-even May 2028, ~$26k cash needed, $119k profit in 2029.
Audio recording guide written for the speaker.
Built the voice recorder: 196 clips (names, sounds, syllables, words), saves progress in the browser, exports one zip. Tested with a simulated mic.
Owner chose the name Sindibad and owns sindibad.studio. Renamed app, landing page, tracker and docs to Sindibad Letters · حروف سندباد.
Owner turned on GitHub Pages. All links now point to shibl.github.io/learnArabic; githack kept as a backup mirror.
Outreach kit ready: WhatsApp messages in EN / FR / Arabic, weekend-school email, and a brand-name shortlist (recommend Hudhud).
Go-to-market: pilot via WhatsApp parent groups, weekend schools, community centres; creators + Ramadan challenge for launch.
Landing page live (EN/FR): 'Your child hears Arabic every day. Now they can read it.' with try-free and pilot call to action.
Owner asked for a financial model → built a 3-year monthly model in code with low/base/high/lean scenarios. Lean path breaks even Sep 2028 needing ~$70k; LTV $84 vs CAC $15 (5.6×).
Tested end-to-end in a headless browser: full lesson for ب completes with 3 stars, no errors. Tightened tracing check so scribbles don't pass.
App MVP playable: profiles, 7 letter islands, letter lessons with forms & picture words, 4 games (listen, first sound, shape match, finger tracing), stars, streaks, parent corner, EN/FR, offline.
Brand v0: warm sand/teal/coral palette, Baloo Bhaijaan 2 (Arabic + Latin), guide character Hudhud the hoopoe.
Letter dataset done: 28 letters, sounds in EN/FR, 84 picture words, home-dialect variants (e.g. طماطم ↔ بندورة / قوطة / مطيشة).
Learning path: 4 levels; level 0 = 28 letters in 7 'islands' ordered by teachability (shape families first, emphatics last).
Personas written (2 kids, 2 parents, 1 teacher) and MVP scope locked: 28 letters, 4 games, offline PWA, EN/FR.
Business model: free alphabet forever, family plan $6.99/mo or $49/yr, weekend-school plan $2/student/mo.
Competitor scan: closest is Amal (heritage-focused, $7.99–13.99/mo); Lamsa targets kids inside the Arab world.
Market: diaspora ~30–50M; first-wave target ~250–300k families in FR, US, DE, CA, UK, AU, SE.
Pushed tracker to GitHub. Enabling Pages needs the repo owner — added to 'Needs you'.
Tracker dashboard built: domains, board, activity log, roadmap, decisions, live commits.
Project kicked off. Repository connected; starting the live work tracker.
